description: This file defines the 'Extract' class within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library, providing static methods for string extraction operations such as LEFT, MID, RIGHT, and text before/after functions, including array handling features.

classes.name: Extract
classes.description: Provides static methods for string extraction functions similar to Excel's text extraction functions, with support for array inputs and multilingual characters.

methods.name: left
methods.description: Extracts the leftmost characters from a string or array of strings.

methods.name: mid
methods.description: Extracts a substring from a string given a start position and length or from an array of strings.

methods.name: right
methods.description: Extracts the rightmost characters from a string or array of strings.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Returns the part of the text before a specified delimiter, with options for instances, case sensitivity, and matching mode.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Returns the part of the text after a specified delimiter, with options similar to 'before'.
